decisions.F01: Font family is sToken HarmonyOS Sans SC; not bundled. Qt fallback applies when unavailable; Field retains Microsoft YaHei UI fallback.
decisions.F02: Popup bounds, preferred width and textarea row defaults remain local parameters. Action Loading reuses the Button contract.
decisions.F03: The sToken embedded interaction size resolves to 24px in all four current runtime configurations; the shared Input/Select field adapter applies a 32px minimum height and 14px minimum body font size.
decisions.F04: Surface presets use the same checkbox-contract.json data; borderless and underlined preserve their structural border semantics and have no decorative shadow.

sourcePolicy: sToken overlay via the canonical parser; Input and Select share component.basic.input. Unspecified popup bounds and layout defaults remain explicit project contract values.
